name: Ibn Arabshah
contribution: An Arab writer and traveller who lived under the reign of Timur.
legacy: In his critical biography of Timur, Aja'ib al-Maqdur, written in Arabic, this person highlighted Timur's illiteracy of Arabic and his preference for Persian literature.

checks.lead: Abu Muhammad Shihab al-Din Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Ibrahim also known as Muhammad ibn Arabshah (Arabic: ابن عَرَبْشَاه; 1389–1450), was an Arab writer and traveller who lived under the reign of Timur (1370–1405).
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
